anti_overfit_boundary: The exact synthetic truth parameter pair bias=-0.30,slope=1.00 is excluded from the candidate family.
No candidate, coefficient, baseline, threshold, seed, race, or stratum change after design scoring.
If no design candidate passes, evaluation seed 20260925 must remain unaccessed.
No v4 evaluation seed reuse, no real/historical input, no odds, RESULT/PAYOUT, ROI, bankroll or economics input.
A synthetic pass does not promote a real Keirin model or authorize any real/economics scope expansion.
design_gate: Adaptive overall mean KL must be strictly lower than the best universal baseline overall mean KL.
Adaptive KL in every LOW/MID/HIGH stratum must be <= 1.02x the best universal baseline for that stratum.
LOW and HIGH design stratum counts must each be >= 60.
evaluation_gate: Frozen adaptive overall mean KL must be <= 0.98x the best universal baseline overall mean KL.
Frozen adaptive KL in every LOW/MID/HIGH stratum must be <= the best universal baseline for that stratum.
LOW and HIGH evaluation stratum counts must each be >= 100.
frozen_selection_order: lowest worst stratum ratio to best universal
purpose: Re-test PRE-only adaptive mixture after replacing the inadequate N1 W2-side component with preregistered, independently synthetic-validated N2.
